entries.name: Cinco de Mayo
entries.capsule: A 1862 Mexican military victory, celebrated on St. Paul's West Side with a large parade, car show, music and food.
entries.dateRule: May 5. The West Side celebration is held on a nearby weekend announced each year by organizers.

dates.source: Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday
Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday
Sahan Journal describes the fifth of May holiday

entries.whatItMarks: A Mexican military victory in 1862. Sahan Journal notes it carries little significance in Mexico itself.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: On St. Paul's West Side since 1985, hosted by West Side Boosters and the West Side Fiestas Committee, with a parade on Cesar Chavez Street from Wabasha to Ada, a car show and music. About 30,000 attended in 2025. In 2026 organizers debated holding it during the federal enforcement surge and went ahead on a smaller footprint. Willmar's Latino Community Association held its own celebration on May 16, 2026. Gov. Albert Quie proclaimed May 5, 1981, Cinco de Mayo Celebration Day.

minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Parade and festival Sat., May 2, 2026, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.; car show Fri., May 1, 2026, at Harriet Island. No 2027 date announced.

entries.name: Mexican Independence Day
entries.capsule: Mexico's independence, begun in 1810, marked in St. Paul with a West Side celebration since at least 1939.
entries.dateRule: September 16. West Side Fiestas holds its celebration on a date it announces each year.

dates.source: MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day
MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day
MPR News names Sept. 16 as Mexican Independence Day

entries.whatItMarks: Start of the 1810 war of independence.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: St. Paul's first Fiestas Patrias in 1939 paraded from the West Side downtown. In 1886 a visiting Mexican military band led an Independence Day parade in Minneapolis. West Side Fiestas held a 2026 celebration with car show, music, vendors, crafts, a kids' zone and a community march. West Side Fiestas named Bob Cruz, executive director of the West Side Boosters, grand marshal for its Sept. 12, 2026 celebration. Gov. Tim Pawlenty proclaimed Sept. 16, 2003, Mexican Independence Day in Minnesota.

minnesotaEvents.name: Mexican Independence Day Celebration
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Sat., Sept. 12, 2026, as announced. No 2027 date announced.

entries.name: Día de la Virgen de Guadalupe
entries.capsule: Feast of Mexico's patron, with a one-mile procession and Masses at St. Paul's diocesan shrine.
entries.dateRule: December 12, often beginning the evening before.

dates.source: The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day
The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day
The Catholic Spirit states the Dec. 12 feast day

entries.whatItMarks: The 1531 appearance of the Virgin Mary reported by Juan Diego.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Our Lady of Guadalupe in St. Paul, a diocesan shrine since 2019, holds an annual one-mile procession; about 700 attended the eve Mass in 2019. The Diocese of St. Cloud listed Spanish Guadalupe Masses, mañanitas and suppers in nine parishes in 2019, and on Dec. 14, 2025, Bishop Patrick Neary celebrated the feast at St. Boniface in Cold Spring with a Twin Cities mariachi band. Past celebrations include Church of the Risen Savior in Burnsville (2014) and an Episcopal church in St. Paul (2003). No 2026 schedule had been posted as of Oct. 31, 2026; Dec. 12 falls on a Saturday in 2026.

entries.name: Las Posadas (first night)
entries.capsule: Nine nights re-enacting Mary and Joseph's search for shelter, beginning Dec. 16.
entries.dateRule: Nine nights, December 16 to 24, ending with Nochebuena on Christmas Eve; parishes and families may hold fewer nights.

dates.source: The Central Minnesota Catholic (Diocese of St. Cloud) states the ritual typically takes place Dec. 16 to 24
The Central Minnesota Catholic (Diocese of St. Cloud) states the ritual typically takes place Dec. 16 to 24
The Central Minnesota Catholic (Diocese of St. Cloud) states the ritual typically takes place Dec. 16 to 24

entries.whatItMarks: Mary and Joseph's search for shelter.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2008 Our Lady of Guadalupe in St. Paul held nightly posadas inside the church, with about 100 people walking as pilgrims behind children playing Mary and Joseph, ending with a piñata; organizers said the nights end at midnight on Christmas Eve with Nochebuena (MPR News, 2008). St. Peter in Richfield marks Las Posadas in Advent for Latino parishioners (The Catholic Spirit, 2018), and Risen Christ School in Minneapolis celebrates it (The Catholic Spirit, 2022). No 2026 schedule had been posted as of Oct. 31, 2026.
